zh.name: 黄波
zh.title: 副研究员
zh.address: 湖北省武汉市洪山区鲁磨路388号 430074
zh.bio: 中国地质大学（武汉）副研究员。主要从事前寒武纪地质学、早期地球演化与构造体制、太古宙板块构造等方面的研究工作，研究区域涉及华北克拉通、中亚造山带和特提斯构造域。综合运用野外填图、构造解析、年代学、地球化学、同位素和相平衡模拟等方法，聚焦太古宙TTG-绿岩带、蛇绿岩/混杂岩、变质作用和沉积盆地等关键地质问题。

research_interests.title: 前寒武纪地质与早期地球演化
research_interests.desc: 聚焦华北克拉通和华南克拉通，研究早期地球环境、构造与地球动力学的长期演化

research_interests.title: 太古宙板块构造
research_interests.desc: 研究太古宙俯冲-增生-碰撞构造体制，探索现代板块构造的起始时间与机制

research_interests.title: 蛇绿岩/混杂岩与造山带演化
research_interests.desc: 中亚造山带和特提斯构造域的增生-碰撞演化过程及其地球动力学机制

research_interests.title: 变质地质学与相平衡模拟
research_interests.desc: 运用相平衡模拟方法研究变质岩的P-T演化轨迹，揭示构造热演化历史

research_interests.title: 沉积物源分析与盆地演化
research_interests.desc: 通过碎屑锆石年代学和地球化学方法，分析沉积盆地的物源特征与构造背景

en.name: Bo Huang
en.title: Associate Professor
en.address: 388 Lumo Road, Hongshan District, Wuhan, Hubei 430074, China
en.bio: Associate Professor at China University of Geosciences, Wuhan (CUG). Research focuses on Precambrian geology, early Earth evolution and geodynamics, and Archean plate tectonics, with field areas in the North China Craton, Central Asian Orogenic Belt, and Tethyan tectonic domain. Integrates field mapping, structural anatomy, geochronology, geochemistry, isotope analysis, and phase equilibrium modelling to investigate Archean TTG-greenstone belts, ophiolite/mélanges, metamorphism, and sedimentary basins.

research_interests.title: Precambrian Geology & Early Earth Evolution
research_interests.desc: Secular changes of environment, tectonics, and geodynamics of the early Earth, with focus on the North and South China cratons

research_interests.title: Archean Plate Tectonics
research_interests.desc: Subduction-accretion-collision processes in the Archean, exploring the onset and mechanisms of modern-style plate tectonics

research_interests.title: Ophiolite/Mélange & Orogenic Belt Evolution
research_interests.desc: Accretionary and collisional evolution of orogenic belts in Central Asia and the Tethyan domain

research_interests.title: Metamorphic Geology & Phase Equilibrium Modelling
research_interests.desc: P-T evolution of metamorphic rocks using phase equilibrium modelling to reveal tectonothermal histories

research_interests.title: Sedimentary Provenance & Basin Analysis
research_interests.desc: Detrital zircon geochronology and geochemistry for provenance analysis and tectonic setting reconstruction
